lines: I like how easy it feels to be close to you.
You have a way of making even small moments feel special.
I was trying to act normal, but you make that difficult.
I like this. Just talking with you, being near you... all of it.
There is something about you that makes me smile before you even say anything.
I get nervous around you, but I think I would miss the feeling if it stopped.
You make silence feel less awkward. That is new for me.
I keep trying to act normal around you. It is not going very well.
I like being close to you. I am just terrible at looking calm about it.
Every time you look at me, I forget what I was pretending to think about.
You keep looking at me like that, and I am going to forget what I was doing.
I like this. You, me, this little moment before one of us says something foolish.
I was behaving perfectly well until you got close.
There is something very distracting about you.
If you are trying to make me think about you all day, it is working.
I keep telling myself this is a bad investment. I am starting to think I am wrong.
You are becoming a very distracting expense in my day.
I was counting profits. Then I started thinking about you. Terrible for business.
I like having you close. Do not make me put a price on that.
Some things are worth more than emeralds. Annoyingly, you might be one of them.
You are very distracting. I hope you are proud of yourself.
I was having a perfectly normal day until you made it complicated.
Do not look so pleased. I am only happy to see you a little.
You make it hard to stay annoyed. That is irritating.
I still do not know what to do with you. That might be the problem.
You are still far too easy to notice.
I was doing fine before you started being interesting.
Do not look so smug. I only like you a reasonable amount.
You make it very hard to pretend I am unimpressed.
I have not decided if you are trouble or entertainment. Maybe both.
Some silences say more when you are near.
I have learned not to ignore what I feel around you.
You make patience feel less like waiting and more like wanting.
There is a quiet pull between us. I think we both know it.
I was trying to think clearly. Then you made that difficult.
I can face a lot of things without blinking. You are not one of them.
Being close to you makes me feel bold in a completely different way.
I like this feeling. It is a little dangerous, but I like it.
You make calm moments feel like something is about to happen.
I have walked into danger with less trouble than I have walking up to you.
When you talk to me like that, it is really hard not to get attached.
That was sweet. You are very good at making me feel wanted.
I like when you are gentle with me. It stays with me longer than you think.
You keep finding little ways to make me like you more.
That was kind of unfair. Now I am going to think about it for ages.
fail: That was almost sweet. I think the words got a little lost.
I know you were trying to be kind, but that came out strangely.
I wanted that to sound romantic. It did not quite get there.
That was nice in theory. Very confusing in practice.

lines: When you are sweet to me, I do not know where to put all the feelings.

That came out a little strange. I am still trying to decide how strange.

lines: When you are sweet to me, it is honestly unfair.

lines: That was sweet. Suspiciously sweet.
